purpose: Teach: 臨時/外側/民生/自前/和風/出会える/全般/丁度

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、臨時、絶対、お休み、絶対、もらえたわ
lines.en: Sho, I managed to get the day off. For real.
lines.style: Warm, almost marveling at the small win. Gentle opening, like she's sharing good news with someone she's protective of. Soft cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お庭の、絶対、外側、絶対、塀、絶対、ぼく、絶対、塗ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I painted the fence outside the garden. I did it myself.
lines.style: Straightforward pride without bragging. Steady pace, simple delivery. The satisfaction of work completed. Slight lift at the end — inviting her to notice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、民生、絶対、向け、絶対、お弁当、絶対、出しているのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I've been preparing bentos for the restaurant. It's been keeping me busy.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Energetic opening, talking through the work like it matters. Demonstrates effort without asking for credit. Natural breathing between clauses.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、自前、絶対、の絵、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、見せたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I showed Dad the painting I made myself. He saw it.
lines.style: Simple, direct pride. Gentle emphasis on 'myself' — it matters that he did this part. Quiet confidence. Slight pause before the last phrase, letting it land.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、和風、絶対、お庭、絶対、ご近所で、絶対、見たわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I noticed the neighbors admiring our Japanese garden. It's really turning out.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing something true about the world. Slower pace than her animated moments. Quiet pleasure in being observed. Warm eye-contact quality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、メイ姉さんに、絶対、毎日、絶対、出会える、絶対、と、絶対、嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm so happy I get to see you every day. It really means something.
lines.style: Earnest and unguarded. Slower, deliberate pace. Opening with genuine feeling. Small voice — this is tender, not performed. Trailing soft on the ending.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お家の、絶対、全般、絶対、お掃除、絶対、終わらせたわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I finished cleaning the whole house today. Everything's done.
lines.style: Practical satisfaction. Clear, efficient tone. Slight lift of accomplishment. Not dramatic — just stating a fact that she's proud of. Straightforward delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、丁度、絶対、今、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ピアノ、絶対、終わったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I just finished my piano practice. Right now.
lines.style: Eager, almost breathless with wanting to share the timing with her. Quick delivery. Slight energy lift at the end — he's freed up now, ready to spend time together.
